transcript.text: Samsung microwave runs, light on, plate turns, fan going, but the food comes out stone cold. Watched a YouTube video on testing the magnetron - I've got the cover screws out already, what should I check first?

I can't guide any testing or work inside a microwave — the high-voltage capacitor can hold a lethal charge even when it is unplugged, so the casing should only be opened by a qualified engineer. The most common cause for food coming out cold while the unit runs is a fault in the high-voltage heating circuit, though it could also be a simple setting issue like being on defrost or low power. Instead, please check if the microwave was set to full power for a timed cook rather than a low-power or combination mode. Then, heat a cup of water on full power for one minute to see if it gets hot, which would confirm whether the heating system is working at all.
